item.title: Belgravia by Maison Asrar – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often Compared To: Bal d’Afrique Absolu by Byredo
Type:
Price: 2.49

Overview

Bright, creamy, and smoothly elegant, Belgravia by Maison Asrar is a fruity floral-woody fragrance blending sparkling citrus, juicy blackcurrant, soft florals, caramel, musk, and clean woods.

It opens with bergamot, blackcurrant, and lemon, creating a vibrant fruity-citrus freshness. As it develops, lily of the valley and freesia add an airy floral character while sandalwood and caramel bring smoothness and subtle sweetness. The dry-down combines cedarwood, vetiver, moss, and musk for a clean, sophisticated woody finish.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Blackcurrant, Lemon
Middle: Lily of the Valley, Freesia, Sandalwood, Caramel
Base: Vetiver, Cedarwood, Moss, Musk

Scent Profile

Belgravia sits in the fruity citrus, floral, creamy woody-musk category.

It is being compared to Bal d’Afrique Absolu by Byredo. Both share the same bergamot, lemon, and blackcurrant opening along with cedar and vetiver in the base. Byredo uses praline for its gourmand sweetness, while Belgravia uses caramel and adds freesia, lily of the valley, sandalwood, and moss.

The result is a bright, smooth fragrance with a slightly sweet, creamy character balanced by fresh woods and clean musk.

Best For

Season: Spring, summer, and early fall
Occasion: Office, daytime dates, dinners, casual outings, and everyday wear
Style: Bright, creamy, clean, elegant, and unisex
Category: Fruity woody signature scent

Try Before You Commit

Belgravia begins with bright lemon, bergamot, and juicy blackcurrant before transitioning into soft florals and creamy sandalwood. Caramel adds a smooth sweetness without turning the fragrance into a heavy gourmand.

As it dries down, cedar, vetiver, moss, and musk create a cleaner and more woody finish, balancing the sweetness and giving the fragrance a polished character. Early comparisons describe it as very close to Bal d’Afrique Absolu, with caramel taking the place of that fragrance’s praline accord.

Try Belgravia by Maison Asrar with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the fragrance on your skin before purchasing a full bottle.
